<!-- Adding a game? See CONTRIBUTING.md. Otherwise, delete this checklist. -->

**The game:** <!-- what it is, in a sentence or two; a screenshot is lovely -->

- [ ] Everything is in `src/games/<id>/`, and nothing outside it changed
- [ ] `npm run check:games` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] I've played it through, on a computer (and on a phone, if I could)
- [ ] Any art or sounds I didn't make allow this, and say where they're from
- [ ] I'm happy for it to be shared under the site's licence (Apache 2.0)
